title: Discussion and possible action to approve CFAC's comment letter on the California Board of Forestry
text:
[NEW BUSINESS- DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE MOTION]
Discussion and possible action to approve CFAC's comment letter on the California Board of Forestry
and Fire Protection's November 2026 Zone 0 emergency regulations, and to authorize the Chair to submit it
to Council File 25-1428-S1 and Council File 25-1428 and send it to City Council members. Link to letter.
(10 minutes)
summary: The committee is deciding whether to approve and send a comment letter to the state Board of Forestry and Fire Protection on its November 2026 Zone 0 emergency wildfire regulations, and to forward it to City Council.
